calculation_handling.description: A crisis care shelter must be at least 250 m from a lot with a crisis care shelter or municipal shelter, measured lot line to lot line.
calculation_handling.gaps: Locations of other shelters are not held; separation_m is a same-lot building distance.

units.disclosure: The 250 m minimum distance between shelters is not evaluated; the locations of other shelters are not held.

calculation_handling.description: A crisis care shelter must be on a lot with a front or side lot line abutting a major street on the Policy Areas Overlay Map, or a street intersecting one within 80 m of the intersection.
calculation_handling.gaps: The Policy Areas Overlay Map and street intersections are not held.

units.disclosure: The major-street location requirement (including the 80 m intersection arm) for crisis care shelters is not evaluated; the Policy Areas Overlay Map is not held.

150.20.30.1(1).explanation: A crisis care shelter must be at least 250 m from another crisis care or municipal shelter lot, and on a lot abutting a major street on the Policy Areas Overlay Map, or a street meeting one with the lot within 80 m of that intersection.
